capabilities: Sync vault files to Dropbox with a change preview before applying
Record deletion tombstones so stale devices cannot restore deleted notes
Preserve concurrent edits as copies in Sync Conflicts/
Show sync status and controls in a left sidebar panel
Verify downloaded payloads against SHA-256 content hashes
extras: Manual sync only; 100 MiB per-file limit; .obsidian config, .trash, .git and empty directories excluded by default; OAuth refresh tokens stored in local plugin data; changing Dropbox account, App Key, or Vault ID after syncing is unsupported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in sync across Windows and iPhone through Dropbox while preserving deletions and concurrent edits.

relations.evidence: Do not run Remotely Save and Synced Vault simultaneously on the same vault.
the visible Trash/ folder used by Synced Trash

summary: Preview-first Dropbox sync plugin for Obsidian on Windows and iPhone that syncs notes, attachments, images, and the visible Trash/ folder.
